text.title: FreshDrop app, Moscow family buyer, first weekly shop
text.actor: Busy parent, Moscow: full weekly shop before 21:00
text.exp5: Reorder hidden in profile: 6 of 10 never find it
text.ins2: Show the total in the cart
text.ins4: Live courier map on the order page
text.ins5: Put reorder on the home screen
text.decision: Bottleneck: evening slots after 18:00 (22% drop). Test 2 extra slots in 3 Moscow districts from 1 November; check slot-to-order conversion on 15 November.
